mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.consent_template (consent_template_id, template_code, template_name, processing_activity_id, template_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{detail.consentTemplateId}, #{detail.templateCode}, #{detail.templateName}, #{detail.processingActivityId}, #{detail.templateStatus}, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{actorId}, #{now})

INSERT INTO seal.consent_template_version (consent_template_version_id, consent_template_id, processing_activity_id, processing_activity_version_id, version_number, workflow_status, title, introduction_html, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{version.consentTemplateVersionId}, #{version.consentTemplateId}, #{version.processingActivityId}, #{version.processingActivityVersionId}, #{version.versionNumber}, #{version.workflowStatus}, #{version.title}, #{version.introductionHtml}, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{actorId}, #{now})

INSERT INTO seal.consent_item_definition (consent_item_definition_id, consent_template_version_id, processing_activity_version_id, item_order, item_code, item_type, item_title, required, purpose_text, retention_text, refusal_notice, third_party_recipient) VALUES
(#{item.itemId}, #{versionId}, #{processingActivityVersionId}, #{item.order}, #{item.code}, #{item.type}, #{item.title}, #{item.required}, #{item.purpose}, #{item.retentionText}, #{item.refusalNotice}, #{item.thirdPartyRecipient, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO seal.consent_item_data_selection (consent_item_definition_id, processing_activity_version_id, processing_data_item_id) VALUES
(#{selection.itemId}, #{selection.processingActivityVersionId}, #{selection.processingDataItemId})
mapper.select: SELECT template.consent_template_id, template.template_code, template.template_name, template.processing_activity_id, activity.activity_name AS processing_activity_name, template.template_status, template.current_published_version_id, template.version_no AS template_version_no, version.consent_template_version_id, version.processing_activity_version_id, version.version_number, version.workflow_status, version.title, version.introduction_html, version.created_by, version.review_requested_by, version.approved_by, version.published_by, version.rejection_comment, version.content_hash, version.version_no FROM seal.consent_template template JOIN seal.consent_template_version version ON version.consent_template_id = template.consent_template_id JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = template.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE template.consent_template_id = #{templateId} AND version.consent_template_version_id = #{versionId} FOR UPDATE OF template, version

SELECT consent_item_definition_id AS item_id, item_order, item_code, item_type, item_title, required, purpose_text, retention_text, refusal_notice, third_party_recipient FROM seal.consent_item_definition WHERE consent_template_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY item_order

SELECT selection.consent_item_definition_id AS item_id, selection.processing_data_item_id FROM seal.consent_item_data_selection selection JOIN seal.consent_item_definition item ON item.consent_item_definition_id = selection.consent_item_definition_id WHERE item.consent_template_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY item.item_order, selection.processing_data_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.consent_template_version SET title = #{version.title}, introduction_html = #{version.introductionHtml}, rejection_comment = #{version.rejectionComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{now}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE consent_template_version_id = #{version.consentTemplateVersionId} AND workflow_status = 'DRAFT' AND version_no = #{version.versionNo}
